fields.summary_ko.0: Semiconductor stocks including Seagate, Lam Research, Marvell Technology, onsemi, and Western Digital rebounded as concerns over AI data center construction eased following news of Democratic control of Congress, with these stocks rising 3–4% or more compared to the S&P 500 technology sector's +2%.
